The main goal of this tender is the implementation and support of a long-distance (Inter-City) Quantum Key Delivery Systems, the building and maintaining of QKD links to allow Suomen Erillisverkot to test and deploy a range of QKD solutions to our users. This tender is written within the context of the Finnish EuroQCI project called NaQCI.fi. The goal of this project is “to introduce, evaluate and develop Quantum Communication Infrastructure (QCI) in Finland”. Finnish NaQCI.fi is a consortium of multiple experts on quantum technology, brought together to deploy the first quantum network for research in Finland. The main goal of the NaQCI.fi project is to test and gain experience on QKD technology both for metropolitan and long-distance links in Finland. Short-range metropolitan links will be the natural starting point from a technical, logistic, and cost point of view but reaching a good level of experience with long-distance links will be key to the future deployment of the actual national QCI backbone. Testing activities will cover not only QKD devices, but also their integration with classical security components part of traditional communication networks. The target is thus to reach the technical knowledge, practical experience and know-how to build-up and maintain the first experimental QKD networks for public and governmental use and to demonstrate first pilot use cases on both types of links. NaQCI.fi is a part of the EuroQCI initiative and is co-funded by the EU through the Digital Europe Program and the Finnish Ministry of Finance (Valtionvarainministeriö). More details can be found on NaQCI.fi If Tenderer uses subcontractors, The subcontractors used to provide the services shall be listed in the Request to participate.
